name: ecommerce-api-newman
description: Postman collections for the e-commerce REST API, run with Newman

scripts.test: newman run collections/ecommerce-api.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api-flow.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "E-Commerce API flow"
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/registration-validation.postman_collection.json -e environments/local.postman_environment.json -d data/registration-validation.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/registration-validation.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Registration validation"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:data
